subject: prd/plan-new
statement: When invoked to plan a feature, the planner shall accept as governing input only an approved technical design together with its approved PRD projection, refusing any other input with a defect naming what is missing or unapproved.
rationale: plans derive from human-approved contracts only — the interim stage-6 gate (NG-2)
fit_criterion: fixture matrix (missing design / draft design / missing PRD / approved pair): the first three refused with the named defect, the last accepted
